initiative.title: Collections (Notion-style databases)
initiative.summary: Typed collections whose rows are notes, with table/board/gallery/calendar views on collection pages and embedded, editable in notes. Built on the block-storage layer through narrow seams.
initiative.next_action: Review and merge the stack bottom-up; after block storage lands, move CollectionViewNode into the shared schema and switch note-summary.ts to DocBlock.

sources.anchor: model Doc (meta Json, no userId), TaskItem, TimeBlock
combobox, date-picker, tags-input, rating-group, menu, drawer

claims.statement: Collect table-like collections of things with rich details, Notion-database style.
A row is a note (Doc with block content) plus typed properties.
Collections have their own pages and can be embedded as views in notes.
Board, gallery, and calendar views are in this build alongside table.
First uses: reading/media, projects/work items, people/contacts, research/ideas.
One collection per note; collection owns schema, note holds values.
Existing notes can be added to a collection; meta values map onto properties.
Relations, rollups, and formulas are deferred.
Tasks and time blocks stay separate; no convergence.
Stacked PRs, run tonight; sessions may be split for context.
Property set: few storage kinds with display formats (text, number, select, status, multi-select, date w/ end+time, checkbox, created/updated); cover is a view setting.
Note storage is moving to blocks; build everything else and depend on it narrowly. Block work will be in place at implementation.
Rows are separate records with optional lazily-created note; DataTableCell typed value table; relation/rollup tables scaffolded early.

conflicts.resolution: User chose rows-are-notes in Q&A round 1; old PRD record model superseded.

shape.appetite: One night of stacked PRs (8), each shippable.
shape.problem: Notes are flexible but weak for repeated structured collections; need typed properties and multiple views without a second note system.
shape.recommended_shape: Collection/Property/View tables; values as JSON map on Doc keyed by property id; shared isomorphic engine for filter/sort/group/aggregate; four view components behind one host contract usable on pages and in a collectionView block node.
shape.counterproposal: Strongest simpler alternative: rows as notes with Doc.meta key/values and a filtered list page only. Rejected: untyped values cannot drive board/calendar/footers or option renames; user asked for four views and embeds.

success_moves.move: Store values on Doc instead of a cell table
success_moves.risk_reduced: One identity for rows; no join/sync between row records and notes.
Concurrent board drag + cell edit lost updates.

success_moves.move: One pure isomorphic engine (server SSR + client)

first_proof.question: Does values-on-Doc with per-property patches give a fast, correct, notes-native table?
first_proof.artifact: Seeded 300-row Reading collection table at /collections/:id with all property editors and peek panel

first_proof.decision_rule: If patches lose updates or page fetch >300ms at 300 rows, move to a value table before PR 2
